date_note: The article dates the attack 19 November; the page reporting the portal back online was published 25 November, and that is the date used.
geo_basis: state government named in the article; pin at the state capital Maceió
title: Alagoas state government news portal back online on new platform after hacker attack on 19 November, report says
summary: Notícias de Maceió reports that the Alagoas state government official news portal went offline after a hacker attack on the night of 19 November and is back on a new platform, with content being restored gradually. The article says no information was lost and the intruder did not access that data. It says the incident sped up a migration already under way.
plain: Notícias de Maceió reports that the Alagoas government news site, taken down by a hacker attack on 19 November, is back on a new platform. The article says no information was lost.
exec: A state government website was taken down by an attack and relaunched; the article says no data was lost.

validation.note: Only Notícias de Maceió read; the state government statement was not read directly.

review.note: Compared attack night of 19 Nov, new platform, no data lost, publication day against Alagoas 24 Horas
